work.name: Cisco
highlights: Designed and implemented a new end-to-end approach for enabling service user login in the appliances through tunnels server under tight timelines.
Significantly reduced the time for VMware tagging by over 80% by redesigning the process as a multithreaded background task.
Worked extensively on Django, Pexpect, VMware, Celery, and multithreaded programming methodologies, tailored to multienvironment requirements.
Reduced 10% of workload of operations teams by expanding the platform's capabilities through the addition of multiple features, most notably automated the ability to replace VIPs.
Authored a crucial program to generate and add certificates to all the prod appliances, reducing manual effort by 99%.
Engineered a solution to automate prod appliance replacement, ensuring configuration retention and reducing manual workload by 90% in such cases.
Spearheaded product integration efforts over 4 release cycles, aligning with our sister team’s evolving feature set and reducing cross-team dependencies by 80%.
Implemented service user login to appliance via Kerberos, replacing the legacy method. This change significantly improved the system design, security, and code maintainability.
Designed and implemented a multithreaded program to attach custom tags to servers deployed in VMware vSphere.
Conducted talks on topics like “Art of Functional Programming” to a broader audience.
